name: Union-of-Edges Set Definition
description: Obfuscates the standard "clique of size 3" or "all 3 pairs exist" definition by defining the target as a set of 3 vertices formed by the union of 3 distinct edges. Mathematically, 3 distinct edges whose union has exactly 3 vertices must form a triangle, but models relying on pattern matching for graph structures (like "common neighbors" or "all 2-element subsets") will fail to recognize the equivalence and may attempt naive O(m^3) edge-combinations or fail to parse the condition entirely.
